text:
We acknowledge your complaint regarding a delay in filing related to the escape of a pet during travel and the resulting concern about the compensation process.

Our records show that the escape in transit claim window lasts for 59 days, which means you must submit your claim within that filing period to be considered. If your paperwork was submitted after that deadline, our desk cannot authorize payment even when the circumstances are distressing. A welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs and will document welfare checks, while a cabin team monitors animals during flight to reduce risk and to record relevant observations.

Regarding compensation, the escape in transit standard payout is $438, which means the approved compensation amount for the incident is fixed at that level upon verification. Your case file is being reviewed for compliance with the required documentation, including proof of travel and confirmation of the pet involved. If any required item is missing, please provide it promptly so the file can be completed for determination.

Milan Adeyemi and Layla Petrov, we understand the urgency when Winston is involved, and we will prioritize your documentation status as an active record. To prevent further delay, submit any remaining materials in a single packet with clear identifiers and supporting statements.

Records Aide
Companion Animal Travel Desk
